personal_development_targets.description: 6. Deployment | Add personal development targets inside test, syst and prod workspaces? Jobs, models, outputs and endpoints stay user-scoped and schedules start paused. Automatic retraining stays off; endpoint projects also follow the champion with per-user endpoints. Development monitoring is a separate, optional question

deployment_identity.description: 6. Deployment | Shared targets: keep existing deployment ownership, use one service principal, or separate train/score principals; configure IDs in deployment/variables.yml

manage_job_permissions.description: 6. Deployment | Manage shared job permissions in this Bundle? false = keep access managed by your existing platform; true = configure deployment/variables.yml

pipeline_owner.description: 6. Deployment | User email given CAN_MANAGE on every target besides the deployer (your CI may pass --var pipeline_owner). Leave blank to use the deployer

access_groups.description: 6. Deployment | Set access groups for the shared test, syst and prod targets now? Each target has four groups (viewers, runners, serving callers, data readers) in deployment/targets.yml; blank grants nothing and you can fill them there later

test_access_viewers.description: 6. Deployment | test group given CAN_VIEW on jobs, dashboard, project folder and experiment, and the endpoint. Leave blank for no group

test_access_runners.description: 6. Deployment | test group given CAN_RUN (start and cancel) on the target's jobs. Leave blank for no group

test_access_serving_callers.description: 6. Deployment | test group given endpoint CAN_QUERY and SQL function EXECUTE (use an account group). Leave blank for no group

test_access_data_readers.description: 6. Deployment | test group given SELECT on the prediction tables and views the score job writes. Leave blank for no group

syst_access_viewers.description: 6. Deployment | syst group given CAN_VIEW on jobs, dashboard, project folder and experiment, and the endpoint. Leave blank for no group

syst_access_runners.description: 6. Deployment | syst group given CAN_RUN (start and cancel) on the target's jobs. Leave blank for no group

syst_access_serving_callers.description: 6. Deployment | syst group given endpoint CAN_QUERY and SQL function EXECUTE (use an account group). Leave blank for no group

syst_access_data_readers.description: 6. Deployment | syst group given SELECT on the prediction tables and views the score job writes. Leave blank for no group

prod_access_viewers.description: 6. Deployment | prod group given CAN_VIEW on jobs, dashboard, project folder and experiment, and the endpoint. Leave blank for no group

prod_access_runners.description: 6. Deployment | prod group given CAN_RUN (start and cancel) on the target's jobs. Leave blank for no group

prod_access_serving_callers.description: 6. Deployment | prod group given endpoint CAN_QUERY and SQL function EXECUTE (use an account group). Leave blank for no group

prod_access_data_readers.description: 6. Deployment | prod group given SELECT on the prediction tables and views the score job writes. Leave blank for no group
